desc: Ideation: reduce answer for removal i to max depth prefix still shared by >= k remaining strings (on-path prefixes need cnt>=k+1, off-path need cnt>=k).
Implement trie-based solution using heavy nodes (cnt>=k): handle no-heavy, >=2 heavy at deepest depth G, and unique deepest heavy v with G2 = deepest heavy non-ancestor of v.
Run the two provided examples and a randomized brute-force stress test (small alphabet/n, vary k); confirmed PASS with no counterexample (20000 cases).
Validate edge cases: k=1, n=k (all zeros), duplicates/ties, unique longest word removed, all-distinct words, words shorter than G, and max-length inputs for performance/recursion safety.
